screws.name: BATCH-1784945360_crop_1.jpg
screws.reason: Multiple linear surface scratches are visible on both the upper and lower unthreaded shank sections of the screw. These imperfections exceed acceptable surface finish standards.

screws.name: BATCH-1784945360_crop_2.jpg
screws.reason: A prominent vertical crack is observed on the unthreaded shank of the screw, extending from below the head towards the threaded section. This indicates a significant structural integrity issue.
screws.summary: The screw exhibits a significant crack on its shank, rendering it unsuitable for use and requiring immediate rejection.

screws.name: BATCH-1784945360_crop_3.jpg
screws.reason: A distinct vertical crack is observed on the screw shank, extending from below the head towards the threaded section. This defect compromises the structural integrity of the fastener.
screws.summary: The screw exhibits a significant crack on its shank, rendering it unsuitable for use and requiring immediate rejection.

screws.name: BATCH-1784945360_crop_4.jpg
screws.reason: The screw exhibits a uniform surface finish, well-formed hexagonal head with clear markings, and consistently cut threads without any visible signs of rust, scratches, cracks, or dents. All features appear to be within acceptable manufacturing tolerances.

screws.name: BATCH-1784945360_crop_5.jpg
screws.reason: A prominent and deep scratch is clearly visible on the unthreaded portion of the screw shaft. This defect could compromise the structural integrity, fatigue life, and overall performance of the screw.
